entry.title: OGS-TS v1: implement once, work with everything
entry.summary: Open Game Standards publishes version 1 of the OGS Telemetry Standard (OGS-TS), an open, royalty-free standard that lets a game describe what is happening in it once, on the player's local network, so every motion platform, haptic device, dashboard, light and accessibility device listening can understand it.

entry.title: How OGS-TS works, and why it's built this way
entry.summary: For developers deciding whether to adopt OGS-TS: three frames on one multicast group, one canonical encoding with no runtime libraries, a conformance corpus, and the evidence behind the schema.
